caption:
Quick myth-buster. 🧠

Paying off a loan is good news.
But your score can dip a little afterward, because you have fewer open accounts.
It's usually temporary.

Have you seen this happen?
first_comment: Has your score ever dipped after paying something off? 👇
sources: pattern: nobody tells you / counter-intuitive fact

card.headline: Paid off a loan? Your score can dip.
